summary: Customer wants continuous in-process viscosity and temperature monitoring of a dark, thickening resin during cure to determine when to stop the batch.

facts_stated.text: We mix a thick resin batch in a heated vessel
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We mix a thick resin batch in a heated vessel

facts_stated.text: follow its viscosity and its temperature continuously during curing
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: follow its viscosity and its temperature continuously during curing

facts_stated.text: stop the batch at the right point
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: stop the batch at the right point

customer_premises.claim: Continuous viscosity and temperature measurement will be sufficient to follow cure and determine when to stop the batch.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: follow its viscosity and its temperature continuously during curing, so that we can stop the batch at the right point

customer_premises.claim: A final measurement setup can be selected before the endpoint criterion, required ranges, accuracy, response time, installation point, and process conditions are known.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: Which measurement setup would you suggest?
